remarks: HIGHEST & BEST BID DEADLINE: 6:00 pm Sunday, March 1st. Sun-drenched, stylish and inviting 4 Bed, 3 Full Bath home on .7 acres on a quiet cul-de-sac located in the coveted Greens Farms neighborhood, walkable to grocery, restaurants, shops, schools. Gleaming hardwood floors throughout add warmth and character. Spacious front living room with a show-stopping fireplace connects to cheery dining room. Great entertaining flow with an open concept kitchen and adjoining family room - both with French doors onto a large stone patio overlooking the lush, pretty backyard. New kitchen cabinets plus island, double ovens, two sinks, bar stool counter. Over $216K in recent upgrades: New Roof, Hardie Board siding, Central AC, Whole House Generator, Oil Tank, Cedar Fencing, Tree Landscaping. Flexible floor plan: two Primary options: First-Floor Primary with new en-suite bath or Upper-level with wrap-around balcony and two closets, one walk-in. Luxurious second floor full hallway bath with radiant heat floors, double sink quartz vanity, plenty of storage. Oversized two-car garage, fully-finished walk-out basement with mudroom/laundry, gym, rec room. Fully-fenced backyard with flat areas for playsets/sports. Stellar curb appeal w/stone retaining walls, steps, Belgian Block lined driveway and commanding presence on its elevated "Builder's Prime Lot" at the end of the cul-de-sac - no thru traffic. Peaceful, private property near Metro North, schools, shops - all in fabulous Westport,
